    from rcb_client import Robot
    r = Robot()                                   # finds the service (sim:8000, then localhost:8000), waits for warm-up
    spec = r.spec()                               # action types + dims + limits, cameras, budgets
    obs = r.get_obs()                             # current frames: obs.last["egocentric_mirrored_camera"] -> uint8 HxWx3, obs.meta["proprio"]
    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.2)     # actions: (T, 8); returns the execution video
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", actions)                    # (T, 8); IK per row (see spec)
    res.video["wrist_cam"]  -> mp4 bytes     res.frames["wrist_cam"] -> uint8 (N,H,W,3) if video="frames"/"both"
    res.last["wrist_cam"]   -> uint8 HxWx3   res.proprio -> float32 (N, 30)   res.meta -> dict (done, plan, clipped, ...)
    res.save("/app/runs/003")                  # meta.json, <cam>.mp4, frames/<cam>/NNN.jpg, last/<cam>.jpg, proprio.npy

    def get_obs(self, cameras=("egocentric_mirrored_camera", "over_shoulder_left_camera", "wrist_cam"), seconds: float = 0.0,
                video_fps: int = 5, include_depth: bool = False, video: str = "frames") -> Result:
        """Current frames (seconds=0, free) or hold the last command and watch for `seconds` (returns the video)."""

    def status(self) -> dict:
